description: This file defines an internal class 'AllCompatibleVersionsSelector' implementing the 'IVersionSelector' interface. It provides logic to select compatible versions from a list of available versions based on a compatibility check performed by the 'compatibilityDirector'.

classes.name: AllCompatibleVersionsSelector
classes.description: An internal class that selects all versions compatible with a requested version.

methods.name: GetSuitableVersion
methods.description: Returns an array of available versions that are compatible with the requested version, using the provided compatibility director.
